# React Bits — vendored reference sources

Original components from [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev) by David Haz, licensed **MIT + Commons Clause**
(see https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md). Fetched from the `@react-bits` shadcn
registry (`<Name>-TS-TW`).

These files are **reference only**: they are not compiled, linted, or exported. Ferry's adapted versions live
in `packages/ui/src/**` with the header `// Adapted from React Bits (reactbits.dev) — MIT + Commons Clause`.
